Maya (CS Ops): quick flag 15: our weekly cleanup changed primary_segment for ~120 accounts but the playbook sampler didn't pick up the new segment for 7 accounts. seeing 'segment=null' in the playbook payloads.
Liam (Platform): can you share job id and one sample acct?
Maya (CS Ops): job=segment-cleanup-2024-12-01, sample acct=acct_b2d9. command used: `bulk-set --field primary_segment --value Enterprise --filter created>2024-09-01`
Maya (CS Ops): logs: ```[2024-12-01T05:02:10Z] cleaner INFO set acct_b2d9 primary_segment->Enterprise
[2024-12-01T05:02:11Z] event-emitter WARN dropped-event acct_b2d9 reason="empty-payload"
```
Aria (Onboarding): those 7 include two onboarding trials stuck in "segment unknown" gating checklist. customers pinged.
Liam (Platform): sounds like emitter sometimes sends empty JSON when payload size > 2kb and queue service returns 202 with empty body. temporary mitigation: throttle emitter concurrency and re-enqueue failed ids. I'll run `./scripts/reemit --job segment-cleanup-2024-12-01 --only acct_b2d9,acct_c4f0` in 10m.
Maya (CS Ops): action items: 1) Liam to reemit and throttle; 2) Aria to claim the two trials and notify customers; 3) Maya to open RFC to add payload validation and retry on empty-body responses.
CSBot: playbook alert 1: high drop-rate in event-emitter for segment changes, rate +22% over baseline.
Liam (Platform): ack, pausing next scheduled cleanup until patch is live.
Maya (CS Ops): thanks team, please ping here when reemit completes.
